title: docs(releases/v19): name both protocol-19 step entries that ship in 19.0.0-next.0

_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6JaoLphuot5c2R2SFweEMeNTrP)_
Fixes #37522
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 升级到 19 的用户在 v19 发布页「自动迁移」一节和升级步骤第三步看到的条目数与名单改为与首个预发布实际所含一致。
- 为什么做:发布页漏写了随首个预发布一起发出的表格暂存编辑退役迁移,计数也偏少。
- 出错会怎样:只是文档文字,读者看到的数字或名单不对,可直接撤回本次修改。
- 要你做什么:无。

## What changes

Docs-only fix to `content/docs/releases/v19/index.mdx`, two places, measured at the `@objectstack/spec@19.0.0-next.0` tag (`33a31dc7`):

- The `#migrated-for-you` intro now names both protocol-19 step entries that ship in `19.0.0-next.0` — `protocol-18-range-refused` and `data-table-staged-edit-retired` (#37437) — and says a later prerelease may add more, listed by `os migrate meta`. It does not enumerate main's later step-19 entries (main holds 12).
- The protocol-18 count in the intro and in upgrade step 3 moves from 30 of 31 to the measured 39 of 41.

The page states it covers the `19.0.0-next.N` line starting with `19.0.0-next.0`, so step 19 is worded as true for next.0 without claiming the set is closed.

## Acceptance notes

- Counts are entry files ADDED between `@objectstack/spec@18.6.0` (`958ee035`, an ancestor of the tag) and the tag under `packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/`: 41 added (37 `semantic/`, 4 `retired-keys/`, 0 `retired-defs/`); 39 carry the `18.` prefix, 2 the `19.` prefix. 8 pre-existing step-18 entries were modified, not added, and are not counted.
- The breaking-changes list on this page has no bullet for #37437; adding one is a new row outside this card's file surface, so it is only noted here.

## Verification

`dispatch-gates.mjs --ran`: 52 derived, 42 run, 10 UNRUN, all 10 needing a built `@objectstack/spec` / `@objectstack/lint` and left to CI. Every run family exited 0, including `check:release-notes`, `check:release-page-status`, `check:doc-anchors`, `check:docs-single-h1`, `check-release-section-coverage.mjs --strict`, `check:nul-bytes`. `overlap-check.mjs`: VERDICT clean exit 0.

</details>

Read first: the intro hunk at ~:273. Two-minute check: `git ls-tree --name-only 33a31dc7 packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/ | grep /19\.` should print exactly the two entries named.
